4.1 Example for BswM Configuration
The system designer has to make sure that all pre- and post-conditions are met when
setting a state of the ECU State Manager. As the EcuM shall remain flexible, there is
no validation of the sequence the states are switched by BswM. When the sequence
of states shall be compatible to the sequence of EcuMFixed, the system designer has
to realize this behavior by BswM rules.
